titulo: Lithuania briefs EU allies after drone shot down by Nato jets overnight – Europe live
cuerpo: Minister says discussions are ongoing on how to strengthen the alliance’s eastern flank after security incidents intensify across Europe, including in Denmark and Poland Separately, Vilnius airport was forced to temporarily suspend its operations this morning after another “unidentified object” was reported in its vicinity. The 30-minutes disruption resulted in delays to flights to/from Copenhagen, Tel Aviv, Venice, and Warsaw, among others, LRT said. Continue reading...
